rules.rule: Test files (for example src/test/**, src/*Test*/**, tests/**, *Test.kt, *Test.java, test_*.py) are intentionally NOT shown in this diff, even when the change adds or modifies tests. Never claim that a change lacks tests or test coverage based on the diff alone. If test coverage seems relevant, first search the test source sets with file_find or code_search; comment only if you have confirmed there is no test, and keep such comments at low severity.
